title: Airfares could rise by up to 25% as jet fuel costs surge, says McKinsey
summary: Global jet fuel supplies are facing significant pressure due to geopolitical events and refinery limitations, according to McKinsey. This is driving up costs for airlines, with potential airfare hikes of 20-25% expected as fuel prices surge.
